|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|thread_pool_search_throttled_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool. See documentation for exact details. Do note this may have maximum value depending on CPU count - value is automatically lowered if set to higher than maximum value.|
|thread_pool_analyze_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool. See documentation for exact details. Do note this may have maximum value depending on CPU count - value is automatically lowered if set to higher than maximum value.|
|thread_pool_get_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool. See documentation for exact details. Do note this may have maximum value depending on CPU count - value is automatically lowered if set to higher than maximum value.|
|thread_pool_get_queue_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool queue. See documentation for exact details.|
|indices_memory_max_index_buffer_size|integer|false|none|Absolute value. Default is unbound. Doesn't work without indices.memory.index_buffer_size. Maximum amount of heap used for query cache, an absolute indices.memory.index_buffer_size maximum hard limit.|
|indices_recovery_max_concurrent_file_chunks|integer|false|none|Number of file chunks sent in parallel for each recovery. Defaults to 2.|
|indices_queries_cache_size|integer|false|none|Percentage value. Default is 10%. Maximum amount of heap used for query cache. This is an expert setting. Too low value will decrease query performance and increase performance for other operations; too high value will cause issues with other OpenSearch functionality.|
|search_backpressure|object|false|none|none|
|shard_indexing_pressure|object|false|none|none|
|knn_memory_circuit_breaker_enabled|boolean|false|none|Enable or disable KNN memory circuit breaker. Defaults to true.|
|thread_pool_search_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool. See documentation for exact details. Do note this may have maximum value depending on CPU count - value is automatically lowered if set to higher than maximum value.|
|indices_memory_min_index_buffer_size|integer|false|none|Absolute value. Default is 48mb. Doesn't work without indices.memory.index_buffer_size. Minimum amount of heap used for query cache, an absolute indices.memory.index_buffer_size minimal hard limit.|
|indices_recovery_max_bytes_per_sec|integer|false|none|Limits total inbound and outbound recovery traffic for each node. Applies to both peer recoveries as well as snapshot recoveries (i.e., restores from a snapshot). Defaults to 40mb|
|http_max_initial_line_length|integer|false|none|The max length of an HTTP URL, in bytes|
|enable_security_audit|boolean|false|none|none|
|thread_pool_write_queue_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool queue. See documentation for exact details.|
|script_max_compilations_rate|string|false|none|Script compilation circuit breaker limits the number of inline script compilations within a period of time. Default is use-context|
|search_max_buckets|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum number of aggregation buckets allowed in a single response. OpenSearch default value is used when this is not defined.|
|reindex_remote_whitelist|[string \| null]|false|none|Whitelisted addresses for reindexing. Changing this value will cause all OpenSearch instances to restart.|
|override_main_response_version|boolean|false|none|Compatibility mode sets OpenSearch to report its version as 7.10 so clients continue to work. Default is false|
|http_max_header_size|integer|false|none|The max size of allowed headers, in bytes|
|email-sender|object|false|none|none|
|indices_fielddata_cache_size|integer \| null|false|none|Relative amount. Maximum amount of heap memory used for field data cache. This is an expert setting; decreasing the value too much will increase overhead of loading field data; too much memory used for field data cache will decrease amount of heap available for other operations.|
|action_destructive_requires_name|boolean \| null|false|none|none|
|plugins_alerting_filter_by_backend_roles|boolean|false|none|Enable or disable filtering of alerting by backend roles. Requires Security plugin. Defaults to false|
|indices_memory_index_buffer_size|integer|false|none|Percentage value. Default is 10%. Total amount of heap used for indexing buffer, before writing segments to disk. This is an expert setting. Too low value will slow down indexing; too high value will increase indexing performance but causes performance issues for query performance.|
|thread_pool_force_merge_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool. See documentation for exact details. Do note this may have maximum value depending on CPU count - value is automatically lowered if set to higher than maximum value.|
|auth_failure_listeners|object|false|none|none|
|ism-history|object|false|none|none|
|cluster_routing_allocation_node_concurrent_recoveries|integer|false|none|How many concurrent incoming/outgoing shard recoveries (normally replicas) are allowed to happen on a node. Defaults to 2.|
|thread_pool_analyze_queue_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool queue. See documentation for exact details.|
|action_auto_create_index_enabled|boolean|false|none|Explicitly allow or block automatic creation of indices. Defaults to true|
|http_max_content_length|integer|false|none|Maximum content length for HTTP requests to the OpenSearch HTTP API, in bytes.|
|thread_pool_write_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool. See documentation for exact details. Do note this may have maximum value depending on CPU count - value is automatically lowered if set to higher than maximum value.|
|thread_pool_search_queue_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool queue. See documentation for exact details.|
|knn_memory_circuit_breaker_limit|integer|false|none|Maximum amount of memory that can be used for KNN index. Defaults to 50% of the JVM heap size.|
|indices_query_bool_max_clause_count|integer|false|none|Maximum number of clauses Lucene BooleanQuery can have. The default value (1024) is relatively high, and increasing it may cause performance issues. Investigate other approaches first before increasing this value.|
|thread_pool_search_throttled_queue_size|integer|false|none|Size for the thread pool queue. See documentation for exact details.|
|cluster_max_shards_per_node|integer|false|none|Controls the number of shards allowed in the cluster per data node|
